description: DEPTH 6->5 recheck at 5-min proxy budget: budget-dependent-optimum effect reproduces here too (235 steps vs 178, val_bpb 1.405->1.361). UNCONFIRMED pending longer-budget recheck within this tool: this is a capacity-affecting change (changes param count) and TIME_BUDGET=300s vs real 1800s is a 6x ratio, same shape of mistake the real competition just made trusting 400-900s proxies for DEPTH before losing at 1800s. Do not trust without re-checking at >=600-900s single-core budget first, and real 30-min hardware confirmation after that.

DEPTH 5->4 pushes proxy-budget trend further: val_bpb 1.361->1.3608 (marginal, within noise), 289 steps vs 235, smaller/simpler model. UNCONFIRMED pending longer-budget recheck, same caveat as DEPTH=5 row above -- capacity-affecting, only tested at 300s proxy, never rechecked at longer budget before this session's box outage/deadline. Kept only per simplicity criterion given the (unconfirmed) tie with DEPTH=5.

DEPTH 4->3: val_bpb 1.3608->1.368235, worse (321 steps). Confirms DEPTH=4 was near the proxy-budget turning point, not DEPTH=3. Also capacity-affecting/only-300s-tested like the two rows above -- discard decision itself is probably robust (going smaller than the optimum got worse), but the DEPTH=4 vs DEPTH=6 comparison it rests on is still unconfirmed at longer budget.

Input-dependent per-token gating of resid_lambdas/x0_lambdas (Mamba-selective-inspired, Linear(n_embd,1)->sigmoid*2 per layer, zero-init to identity). Result much worse than baseline (val_bpb 1.60 vs ~1.41), 164 steps vs 178 (extra per-token linear+sigmoid overhead per layer, plus presumably harder optimization landscape at this short horizon). Reverting. Non-capacity in param count but clearly not a cheap win at this proxy budget -- discard, not worth a longer recheck.

Prefix-token-prediction-inspired auxiliary loss (deep supervision from layer 3/6, shared lm_head, weight 0.1). Worse than baseline (val_bpb 1.52 vs ~1.41) and only 137 steps vs 178 -- the extra vocab-sized projection each step cost too much step throughput at this short 300s budget to be worth whatever signal it added. Reverting.

MUDD-style dense cross-layer skip connections (zero-init dense_lambdas[i,j] for skip->1-hop). Worse than baseline (val_bpb 1.45 vs ~1.41), 167 steps vs 178 (extra dense-sum compute cost some throughput too). Reverting.
